gwt.given: A DbParameterCollection has no parameters, and a mapped model type carries a collection property annotated [MapToSqlTableValuedParameter("@Children", "ChildTableType")] whose value is an empty List<T> (equivalently: null, ImmutableArray<T>.Empty, or default(ImmutableArray<T>)).
gwt.when: The caller invokes Mapper.CreateInputParameters for that model, which calls SqlParameterCollectionExtensions.AddSqlTableValuedParameter<TModel>(prms, "@Children", collection, logger), and then executes the command against SQL Server through Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.
gwt.then: The collection contains exactly one Input parameter named @Children with SqlDbType.Structured and TypeName ChildTableType whose Value is a null reference (not System.DBNull.Value and not an empty IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>); the command executes without a client-side exception, and the server-side table variable bound to @Children contains zero rows. Today the Value is DBNull.Value and Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 7.0.3 throws NotSupportedException ('Table-valued parameters cannot be DBNull') before any SQL runs; the column-list, keyed-model, and ShardKey overloads instead pass an empty list and the driver throws ArgumentException ('There are no records in the SqlDataRecord enumeration').
